corrections: Replaced the earlier controller wait-completion helper booleans with direct event guards based on pre(mode) and waitElapsed in one dispatcher. This targets the reported chattering at the WAIT_AFTER_FILL timer boundary by avoiding a continuously re-derived intermediate done signal feeding the same mode transition.

Preserved the brief's explicit level-balance equations instead of switching to Modelica.Fluid components, because the brief provides direct level ODEs and does not provide a hydraulic pressure/flow law, medium, or approved mapping from valve stroke time to effective intermediate flow.

Retained valve stroke times as parameters only. The brief states stroke times and also states Boolean commanded valve outputs, but does not provide an explicit command-to-intermediate-flow relationship; therefore no partial-opening flow law was added.
Used command pulse width cmdWidth = 2*scanPeriod = 0.2 s for BooleanTable schedules, matching the retained merged assumption and the instruction that sampled commands be visible to the 0.1 s scan.

Kept physical level floors at 0.0 m, which is strictly below the tested low-level threshold 0.05 m, so level trajectories can cross the acceptance threshold in the required direction instead of stalling at the threshold.

references.reason: Recorded dataset is reference evidence for one run and is consistent with the resolved parameter set; controller state can be compared as a stepwise signal without using it as an input forcing function.
